activity.notes: Julie d'Aubigny, better known on stage as La Maupin, is securely documented as a professional opera singer. The Los Angeles Public Library notes that her operatic career is the best-documented part of her life and places her Paris Opera activity from about 1690 through her retirement in 1705. ATLAS records this documented stage career and does not encode later sensationalized duel or romance anecdotes as authoritative Activities.

sources.title: Julie d'Aubigny: La Maupin and Early French Opera
sources.citation_text: The Los Angeles Public Library identifies d'Aubigny's opera career as the best-documented aspect of her life, describes her Paris Opera debut around 1690, and records her peak return from 1698 until retirement in 1705.
